page_title: PAL 2-1 ATM | Las Palmas v Atletico Madrid 03/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Mario Melero Lopez shows a yellow card to Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) for his unsportsmanlike behavior after the match has ended.
90+9' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+8' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for a foul.
90+5' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
90+3' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) is booked.
90+2' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
90+2' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
90+1' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) misses a great chance. He gets to the rebound inside the box and sees his shot smash against the crossbar!

90+1' A big opportunity is wasted by Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Alvaro Valles pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
89' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
88' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).
87' Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) commits a rough challenge and Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for a foul.

86' Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid) timed his run perfectly to connect with the resulting corner kick, but his finish from around the penalty spot was rather poor as it went well wide of the left post.
85' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
84' The substitution has been made. Sory Kaba (Las Palmas) has replaced Munir El Haddadi.

83' 2 - 1 What a goal! Rodrigo Riquelme plays it to Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid), who finds himself unmarked inside the box and slots a first-time shot past Alvaro Valles into the bottom left corner. 2:1.
81' Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
81' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Atl. Madrid, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.

81' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Mario Melero Lopez blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Atl. Madrid.
79' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
76' Diego Simeone decides to make a substitution. Nahuel Molina will be replaced by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid).
75' 2 - 0 Munir El Haddadi finds Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas) with a sweet pass inside the penalty box, who then smashes the ball inside the left post. What a clinical finish to make it 2:0.
73' A short through ball almost allows Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) to get in a good shooting position, but he loses it to one of the defenders.
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Julian Araujo (Las Palmas) is coming onto the pitch as Marvin cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Maximo Perrone will be replaced by Enzo Loiodice (Las Palmas).
69' The game is interrupted now, Maximo Perrone (Las Palmas) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
65' Diego Simeone has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) replacing Rodrigo de Paul.
65' Substitution. Axel Witsel did his best and is replaced by Jose Maria Gimenez (Atl. Madrid).
63' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alberto Moleiro departs the field of play to be replaced by Benito Ramirez (Las Palmas).
62' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
60' Diego Simeone has decided to make a change. Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) replaces Antoine Griezmann.
60' Substitution. Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) replaces Koke.
57' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.

55' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.

51' 1 - 0 Stunning strike! Kirian (Las Palmas) latches on to a precise through ball from Alberto Moleiro before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 1:0.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Las Palmas comes to nothing.
47' The attendance for today's match is 30080.
46' The whistle blows and Mario Melero Lopez starts the second half.
45+1' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
42' Mario Melero Lopez interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid).
38' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) heads the ball towards goal, but his effort is saved by the goalkeeper.
37' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
36' Javier Munoz (Las Palmas) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jan Oblak intercepts the ball.
34' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.

33' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) gets into a good scoring position. He creates some space for himself and tries his luck from distance. His decent effort towards the middle of the goal is, however, saved by Alvaro Valles!
33' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
32' Kirian (Las Palmas) commits a rough foul. Mario Melero Lopez stops the game and makes a call.
31' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) is flagged for offside.
29' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
26' Kirian (Las Palmas) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.

26' Stefan Savic (Atl. Madrid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Mario Melero Lopez blows for a foul. Free kick. Las Palmas will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
25' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atl. Madrid.

23' Alvaro Valles pulls off a great save to deny Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) who, makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick low drive towards the middle of the goal. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid win a corner kick.
22' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
20' The corner is swung in but Atl. Madrid can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

19' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders. The linesman points to the corner flag, Atl. Madrid are going to take it.
18' The resulting set piece from Las Palmas is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
16' That's an easy save for Alvaro Valles, following a first time shot towards the middle of the goal from Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid).
14' A pass from Marvin (Las Palmas) is intercepted by Jan Oblak and the move breaks down.
12' The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
12' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
10' Munir El Haddadi (Las Palmas) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
8' Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) creates a good chance for himself and goes for goal from mid-range, but the effort is well wide of the left post.
6' A pass from Marvin (Las Palmas) is intercepted by Jan Oblak and the move breaks down.
4' One of the Las Palmas players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
2' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) receives a clever long through ball and finds himself in a promising position inside the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and clears.
